## Description
Please include a summary of the change and which issue it fixes. Also describe relevant motivation and context.

Fixes #(issue)

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] UI/UX refinement (Apple HIG alignment, animation smoothing)
- [ ] Performance optimization
- [ ] Documentation update

## Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of this project (Effective Dart, Apple HIG)
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my own code
- [ ] I have commented my code, particularly in hard-to-understand areas
- [ ] I have verified that no API keys, tokens, or personal paths are introduced
- [ ] `flutter analyze` passes with 0 issues
- [ ] `flutter test` passes all tests
- [ ] Any dependent changes have been merged and published in downstream modules
